mapper.select: /* selectBuyerMpClGoodsDetailInfoCowayHdPopList */ SELECT DECODE(TRIM(BT.IMGFILE_DIR), NULL, (SELECT IMG_DIR FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO = CMS.IMG_NO), BT.IMGFILE_DIR) AS IMGFILE_DIR, DECODE(TRIM(BT.IMGFILE_NAME), NULL, (SELECT IMG_NAME FROM CMSIMGES WHERE IMG_NO = CMS.IMG_NO), BT.IMGFILE_NAME) AS IMGFILE_NAME, BT.CATEGORY_TEXT, BT.CATEGORY_NO, BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO, BT.DESCRIPTION_LOC AS DESCRIPTION, BT.SPECIFICATION, BT.UNIT_MEASURE FROM ICOMBYIT BT, CMSCATLG CMS WHERE 1=1 AND BT.BUYER = #{st_byit_comorg_code} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no} AND BT.CMS_CATLG_ID = CMS.CMS_CATLG_ID(+) AND BT.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND BT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N'

/* selectBuyerMpClGoodsDetailInfoCowayDtPopList */ SELECT DT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE) AS BUYER_NAME, DT.UNIT_PRICE, DT.MAKER_CODE, DT.MAKER_NAME, DT.AGENT, DECODE((SELECT AGENT_OPEN_FLAG FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.BELOW_COMORG_CODE), 'N', '(주)코리아이플랫폼', (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = DT.AGENT)) AS AGENT_NAME FROM ICOMBYIT BT, ICOMCQDT DT WHERE 1=1 AND BT.BUYER = #{st_byit_comorg_code} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = #{st_item_no} AND BT.BUYER_ITEM_NO = DT.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND BT.BUYER = DT.BUYER AND BT.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND BT.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG = 'N' AND DT.STATUS IN ('C', 'R') AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN DT.FROM_DATE AND DT.TO_DATE
